caption: The drawing depicts a single, large pitcher or jug centered within a light tan or off-white rectangular background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of deep purple and violet, with lighter highlights indicating a glass-like reflective surface. It has a rounded, bulbous body that tapers into a narrower neck and then flares outward at the mouth, which is elongated into a spout on one side. The handle, also purple, curves from the upper neck to the body of the pitcher on the left. Three horizontal bands encircle the neck, drawn in a darker, more saturated purple. The inside rim and the base display shading with darker tones, while the body features areas of lighter purple to suggest transparency and reflections. The artist's signature, "John Tarantino," is located at the lower right corner of the inner frame.
title: Cruet
